test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Antonio Stradivari was an Italian __who is being made wonderful__ violins.
solution:
The correct answer is **Who made wonderful.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here ***who made*** refers to the person behind the violins.
